title: Yaleo Adapter Params
description: A schema which validates params accepted by the Yaleo adapter

memberId.description: Member identifier. Defaults to Audienzz member ID 3927 when omitted.

maxCpm.description: Maximum CPM. Bids priced above this value are rejected by the Yaleo bidder.

forceDarkTheme.description: Renders the ad unit in the dark theme.
